column11: the study was discontinued at a futility interim. INTERLINK-1 (NCT04590963, 370 participants, monalizumab plus cetuximab against placebo plus cetuximab in recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma) reached primary completion on 2022-05-11. Innate Pharma's statement of 2022-08-01 reads that 'a planned futility interim analysis ... did not meet a pre-defined threshold for efficacy' and that 'AstraZeneca has informed Innate that the study will be discontinued'.
